title: In Gratitude to Keizan Jokin
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The teacher reflected on the importance of addressing social issues like homelessness through the practice of Zen, drawing inspiration from Dogen's grandson Keizan Jokin, who helped establish a living tradition of Soto Zen in Japan. Keizan's inclusive approach to teaching and his commitment to listening to others informed his writings on Zazen and his leadership of the Dharma Hall ceremony. Through his teachings, Keizan encouraged practitioners to cultivate a deep understanding and freedom that transcends distinctions between worldly and spiritual realms.
